class.name: CgameNetConditioner
class.brief_description: Network condition simulator with latency, jitter, loss, duplication, reordering and a bandwidth cap.
class.description: [CgameNetConditioner] simulates a single FIFO link. Each packet goes through a loss roll, a bandwidth queue (serialization delay, dropped when the backlog exceeds [code]max_queue_ms[/code]), a delay of latency plus uniform jitter in [code][-jitter, +jitter][/code] (never negative), an optional reorder hold and an optional duplicate copy. A per-packet log and a timeline allow inspecting why a packet took the time it did. Time stamps passed to [method send] and [method receive] and all [code]*_at[/code] values are in seconds; latency and jitter are in milliseconds. The simulation is deterministic: the same seed and the same send sequence always produce the same log. [codeblock] var link := CgameNetConditioner.new() link.configure({"latency_ms": 80.0, "jitter_ms": 15.0, "loss": 0.02, "seed": 7}) link.send(0, packet_bytes, now) for p in link.receive(now): handle(p["bytes"]) [/codeblock]

method.name: configure
method.description: Applies a configuration and clears the log and the pending queue. Recognized keys: [code]latency_ms[/code], [code]jitter_ms[/code], [code]loss[/code], [code]duplicate[/code], [code]reorder[/code] (probabilities in [code][0, 1][/code]), [code]bandwidth_kbps[/code] ([code]0[/code] is unlimited), [code]max_queue_ms[/code] and [code]seed[/code].

method.name: delay_cause
method.description: Returns a human-readable breakdown of why a packet took the time it did, or why it was dropped.

method.name: packet
method.description: Returns the log entry of packet [param id] (keys [code]id[/code], [code]channel[/code], [code]size[/code], [code]sent_at[/code], [code]delivered_at[/code], [code]dropped[/code], [code]reason[/code], [code]duplicated[/code], [code]reordered[/code], [code]base_ms[/code], [code]jitter_ms[/code], [code]queue_ms[/code], [code]tx_ms[/code], [code]reorder_ms[/code]), or an empty dictionary for an unknown id.

method.name: packet_count
method.description: Returns the number of packets sent so far.

method.name: pending_count
method.description: Returns the number of packets (including duplicates) still in flight.

method.name: receive
method.description: Removes and returns the packets due by [param now], ordered by delivery time, as dictionaries [code]{id, channel, bytes, sent_at, delivered_at}[/code].

method.name: send
method.description: Submits a packet at time [param now] (seconds) and returns its packet id.

method.name: timeline
method.description: Returns the log entries whose send or delivery time falls in [code][t0, t1][/code], ordered by send time.

members.member: Link bandwidth in kilobits per second; [code]0[/code] means unlimited.
Probability that a delivered packet is duplicated.
Maximum random deviation of the delay, in milliseconds.
Probability that a packet is dropped.
Packets are dropped when the bandwidth backlog exceeds this many milliseconds.
Probability that a packet is held back so that later packets overtake it.
